description: Custom ECL queries for Protein in urine (SNOMED component 88878007, Direct site Urine specimen). The pool is restricted to urine because total protein in serum is a different clinical parameter.
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: Protein in urine, any measurement property
queries.description: All urine protein observables with a measurement property, including ratios to creatinine.
